name: Default
shortDescription: AI email assistant for Gmail and Outlook that triages, labels, drafts replies and bulk-unsubscribes, with PostgreSQL, Redis and a scheduler.

alerts.message: Sign-in needs your own OAuth app. Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET (redirect URIs https://<your-domain>/api/auth/callback/google and https://<your-domain>/api/google/linking/callback), or MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET for Outlook, then redeploy. Sign-up is open to any account until you set AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS or AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS.
The AI features need an LLM provider. Set LLM_API_KEY, and change DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER, DEFAULT_LLM_MODEL, ECONOMY_LLM_PROVIDER and ECONOMY_LLM_MODEL if you do not use Anthropic, then redeploy.

Real-time Gmail processing needs a Google Pub/Sub topic. Set GOOGLE_PUBSUB_TOPIC_NAME and point its push subscription at https://<your-domain>/api/google/webhook?token=<GOOGLE_PUBSUB_VERIFICATION_TOKEN>.
